messages.content: You are the editor in a bounded writing workflow. Follow the user's exact file and role instructions. Be concise.

Read draft.txt and edit it using edit_file. Make the opening sentence more welcoming and add the exact phrase 'repairs are free'. Preserve Saturday, 10 a.m., and 'bring a broken lamp'. Return a short account of your actual edit.
Previous completed handoff: The draft.txt file contains a four-sentence public library announcement for a Saturday Repair Cafe at 10 a.m., which includes the exact phrase "bring a broken lamp." It invites community members to bring items for repair and emphasizes sustainability.
